// 01 — ABOUT— TENTANG

Who I Am

Tentang Saya

I'm Minto, an electrical engineer who's spent the last six years moving between drafting tables, control panels, and job sites — designing systems on paper, then making sure they actually work in the field.

My path has run through wastewater treatment plants, a national railway manufacturer (INKA Group), and an industrial automation R&D lab — with freelance electrical work running alongside all of it since 2019.

What I bring: independent field ownership (sole on-site engineer across 8 facilities), a BNSP-certified eye for CAD drafting, and five years coaching provincial-level vocational students in panel wiring and PLC programming — which means I explain things clearly, not just do them.

Currently based in Yogyakarta, open to relocation, and actively looking for the next challenge — full-time or freelance.

Saya Minto, insinyur elektro yang enam tahun terakhir berpindah antara meja gambar, panel kontrol, dan lokasi kerja — merancang sistem di atas kertas, lalu memastikan benar-benar berfungsi di lapangan.

Perjalanan saya melewati instalasi pengolahan air limbah, produsen kereta api nasional (INKA Group), dan lab R&D otomasi industri — dengan pekerjaan freelance elektro berjalan beriringan sejak 2019.

Yang saya bawa: kemandirian penuh di lapangan (satu-satunya insinyur on-site di 8 fasilitas), ketelitian drafting CAD bersertifikat BNSP, dan lima tahun melatih siswa SMK tingkat provinsi dalam wiring panel dan pemrograman PLC — artinya saya terbiasa menjelaskan, bukan cuma mengerjakan.

Saat ini berbasis di Yogyakarta, terbuka untuk relokasi, dan aktif mencari tantangan berikutnya — baik full-time maupun freelance.

2022 → 2024
01 / 06

DC Chopper Research — From Internship to Cum Laude Thesis

Riset DC Chopper — Dari Magang ke Skripsi Cum Laude

During a hands-on internship in PT Rekaindo Global Jasa's Technology & Operations division (INKA Group, Aug–Nov 2022), I worked on KRDE control panels and static frequency inverter systems for Indonesia's national railway manufacturer. That exposure to 1,500 VDC propulsion systems led to an invitation back in July 2023 for focused R&D on DC Chopper power conversion — hands-on IGBT-based motor control testing with a Hioki multimeter and custom controller hardware. The research became the foundation for my final-year thesis, completed Cum Laude (GPA 3.74) in August 2024.

Selama magang di divisi Technology & Operations PT Rekaindo Global Jasa (INKA Group, Agu–Nov 2022), saya menangani panel kontrol KRDE dan sistem inverter frekuensi statis untuk produsen kereta api nasional Indonesia. Pengalaman dengan sistem propulsi 1.500 VDC ini membawa saya kembali pada Juli 2023 untuk riset terfokus konversi daya DC Chopper — pengujian langsung kontrol motor berbasis IGBT dengan multimeter Hioki dan hardware controller khusus. Riset ini menjadi fondasi skripsi tugas akhir saya, lulus Cum Laude (IPK 3,74) pada Agustus 2024.

IGBT Motor Control1500 VDC PropulsionHioki DiagnosticsThesis · Cum LaudeSkripsi · Cum Laude
2022
02 / 06

Smart Garden — IoT Environmental Monitoring

Smart Garden — Monitoring Lingkungan IoT

A self-initiated IoT build for an Introduction to IoT course: a NodeMCU (ESP8266) reads soil moisture, air temperature, and humidity, then automatically triggers a water pump once soil moisture drops below threshold. Data streams to Adafruit IO over MQTT, with live control from both a web dashboard and the MQTT Dash mobile app. Logged and validated over 3+ continuous weeks of operation — a full sensor-to-cloud-to-app pipeline designed, wired, and coded solo.

Sistem IoT inisiatif pribadi untuk mata kuliah Pengantar IoT: NodeMCU (ESP8266) membaca kelembaban tanah, suhu, dan kelembaban udara, lalu otomatis menyalakan pompa air saat kelembaban tanah di bawah ambang batas. Data dikirim ke Adafruit IO lewat MQTT, dengan kendali langsung dari dashboard web maupun aplikasi MQTT Dash. Diuji dan divalidasi lebih dari 3 minggu operasi berkelanjutan — seluruh alur sensor-ke-cloud-ke-aplikasi dirancang, dirakit, dan diprogram sendiri.
